leadText: Haven Paschall (born Haven Burton) is an American voice actress and singer for the English-language dub of and . She is also a Broadway stage actress.
plainText:
Haven Paschall (born Haven Burton) is an American voice actress and singer for the English-language dub of and . She is also a Broadway stage actress.

==Biography==
Little is known about Paschall's personal life, other than she became a voice actress as an adult. She joined the during the sixteenth season of and provided the voices of several characters, most notably Concordia. In , she received her most prominent role, . In addition to her voice-over work, Paschall has sung a few songs for the series. As of , she is credited by her birth name.
